description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'RiverpodAppShell' that manages a bottom navigation bar with three screens: Lessons, Dashboard, and Profile. It sets up routing between these screens and applies theming. It serves as the main shell of a Flutter app, integrating external screens and themes.

classes.name: RiverpodAppShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides bottom navigation between 'Lessons', 'Dashboard', and 'Profile' screens.

classes.name: _RiverpodAppShellState
classes.description: State class managing the current selected tab index, building the MaterialApp with navigation.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the RiverpodAppShell widget.

methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including the MaterialApp, Scaffold, AppBar, SafeArea, IndexedStack for pages, and NavigationBar.
